## Purpose

Run an AnnData velocity workflow, store velocity and fate summaries, and save the updated `.h5ad`.

## Packages

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
import os
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import scvelo as scv
import cellrank as cr
```

## User Config

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object = "path/to/previous_step.h5ad"
output_object = "path/to/velocity_cellrank.h5ad"
results_dir = "results/velocity_cellrank"
figures_dir = "figures/velocity_cellrank"
sample_column = "sample_column"
group_column = "group_column"
basis = "umap"
n_pcs = 30
n_neighbors = 30
seed = 1
```

## Input Loading

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(figures_dir, exist_ok=True)
adata = sc.read_h5ad(input_object)
```

## Validation

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
required = {sample_column, group_column}
missing = required.difference(adata.obs.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing obs columns: {sorted(missing)}")
```

## Input Summary

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
pd.DataFrame({"n_cells": [adata.n_obs], "n_features": [adata.n_vars]}).to_csv(f"{results_dir}/velocity_input_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
```

## Main Analysis

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
scv.pp.filter_and_normalize(adata)
scv.pp.moments(adata, n_pcs=n_pcs, n_neighbors=n_neighbors)
scv.tl.velocity(adata)
scv.tl.velocity_graph(adata)
scv.tl.velocity_pseudotime(adata)
kernel = cr.kernels.VelocityKernel(adata).compute_transition_matrix()
adata.uns["cellrank_kernel"] = {"type": "VelocityKernel"}
```

## QC Checks

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
adata.obs[[sample_column, group_column, "velocity_pseudotime"]].to_csv(f"{results_dir}/velocity_obs.tsv", sep="\t")
```

## Visualization

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
scv.pl.velocity_embedding_stream(adata, basis=basis, save=None, show=False)
```

## Object Result Storage

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
adata.uns["template"] = {"step": "velocity_scvelo_cellrank", "basis": basis, "n_neighbors": n_neighbors}
```

## Result Export

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
adata.obs.groupby(group_column, observed=True)["velocity_pseudotime"].describe().to_csv(f"{results_dir}/velocity_pseudotime_by_group.tsv", sep="\t")
```

## Final Save

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
adata.write_h5ad(output_object)
```

## Output Summary

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-09-velocity-scvelo-cellrank-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
print({"output_object": output_object, "n_cells": adata.n_obs, "n_features": adata.n_vars})
```
